gloss: defeated nation; loser country (in a war)

definitions.gloss: defeated nation; loser country (in a war)
definitions.explanation: A country that has lost a war, especially in the context of international peace settlements and post-war obligations.

examples.japanese: {戦敗国|せんぱいこく}は{多|おお}くの{賠償金|ばいしょうきん}を{支払|しはら}った。
examples.english: The defeated nation paid large reparations.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}は{第二次世界大戦|だいにじせかいたいせん}の{戦敗国|せんぱいこく}だ。
examples.english: Japan is a defeated nation of World War II.

examples.japanese: {戦敗国|せんぱいこく}の{復興|ふっこう}は{周辺諸国|しゅうへんしょこく}の{援助|えんじょ}によって{進|すす}められた。
examples.english: The reconstruction of the defeated nation was carried out with the help of neighboring countries.

notes:
{戦|せん} (war, battle) + {敗|ぱい} (defeat) + {国|こく} (country). A formal compound used primarily in historical, political, and journalistic writing.

USAGE: More common in writing than in speech. The synonym {敗戦国|はいせんこく} is used more frequently; both refer to the same concept.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {戦勝国|せんしょうこく}: victorious nation
- {敗戦国|はいせんこく}: defeated nation — same meaning, more common
- {敗者|はいしゃ}: loser, defeated party — broader, can apply to individuals
- {戦後|せんご}: postwar — adjective/noun for the period after defeat
